title: Wildly Crispy American Chicken Breast Sandwich
description: A floral and crispy American dish featuring chicken breast and lamination-puff, this sandwich is perfect for adventurous eaters, and is shojin-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Dip each chicken breast into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Place a coated chicken breast in the center of each rectangle, leaving a 1 inch border around the chicken.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water, then fold the pastry over the chicken, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with a little vegetable oil, then place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the chicken for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, mix together the honey, apple cider vinegar, and a little water in a small bowl.
After the chicken has baked for 20 minutes, brush the tops with the honey mixture.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
